chunks: See, how We favour one over the other; and in life to come are higher ranks and favours greater still.

key_terms.الْآخِرَةُ: The Hereafter / The life to come

ai.seo_question: What is the greatest difference between people according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-Isra is often linked to the concept of *Fadl* (divine preference), particularly highlighting the superiority of the Prophets and Imams as the ultimate recipients of this distinction. It underscores that while worldly status varies, the true hierarchy of merit (*Tafdil*) is determined by spiritual proximity to God in the Hereafter. This reinforces the Shia belief in the infallible leadership of the Ahl al-Bayt as the pinnacle of human excellence.
